answer.answer: APY stands for Atal Pension Yojana [E03]. It guarantees a minimum monthly pension of Rs. 1000/-, Rs. 2000/-, Rs. 3000/-, Rs. 4000/-, or Rs. 5000/- per month after age 60 [E02].
